title: Quietly Spicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A spicy and velvety Saudi Arabian dish featuring tender lamb and creamy taleggio cheese, perfect for a flexitarian meal prep option
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours
Stir in the crumbled taleggio cheese and cook until melted and smooth
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot
Let the tagine cool, then refrigerate or freeze for meal prep
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
